scope: scalar_execution only; P1 scalar path; no FSM, cycles, capture, counters, ports or scheduled execution changes

preferred_candidate.name: scalar_mask_lifetime
live_range_proof: KEY digest must be retained across MASK0 and optional MASK1, so temporary_key remains.
chain_value contains the original left operand after request preload or prior chain hash. KEY and MASK PRFs use public_seed/address and do not consume chain_value.

After MASK0 completion, original left operand has no later consumer. Overwrite chain_value with left_value XOR completed_value on the same completed edge; FINAL uses chain_value for chained and standalone requests.

For binary FINAL, MASK1 is the immediately preceding completed hash. Its final-round edge writes sponge_state; digest reads sponge_state. During next START cycle FINAL formats right XOR digest and the launch edge consumes that frame before overwriting sponge_state.
All hash launch/completion edges, compound updates, capture enable tests and statistical updates remain unchanged.
Legal XMSS arities are 1 and 2; existing recipe vectors cover both plus q/address boundaries. Full chained Sign verification remains necessary.
preferred_candidate.expected_structural_gain: Delete two N*8-bit mask register banks (512 FF for N=32); corresponding bank write enables disappear. XOR work moves into chain_value update. LUT and timing gain requires synthesis because this adds one chain_value write-data alternative.
preferred_candidate.conservative_variant: If the full two-bank reuse increases LUT/timing, evaluate mask1-only removal first; this reuses digest without modifying chain_value.
validation_required: P1U1 459 independent SHAKE256 recipe byte-frame vectors including XMSS arity1/2
Nine full Sign tests P1U1/P4U1/P12U1 vs frozen baseline: exact cycles, hashes, permutations, outputs, cache
Normal/SYNTHESIS, capture stalls, reset/error replay, q=1/1023 boundary tests
Common OOC synthesis, frozen source checksum, hierarchical/timing/log archive
